title: E-GRV-0062: a neutral lump in the depth of the bulk does not delay the husk light's front, fail on D2: on the trit...
purpose: Experiment E-GRV-0062 in the gravity arena: a neutral lump in the depth of the bulk does not delay the husk light's front, fail on D2: on the trit light (side 16, D 4, 36 beats) a front kicked at (-3, 0, 0) crosses neutral lumps of 2, 4 and 12 vibes (every column sum zero, kept in place by the rule with no stand-in) and reaches (3, 0, 0) at beat 24 exactly as with no lump, with 0 husk entries differing on any beat, the lump flipped the same, because the husk integer rule is closed on column sums (checked every beat on 13 of 13 configurations); the same vibes placed with nonzero column sums are seen from beat 2 or 3 and make the front arrive EARLIER, at 22, 19, 16 (flipped 21, 21, 14), a charge effect that depends on the sign and speeds the front rather than delaying it; on the adopted knit no lump can stay in a column one beat, since 0 of the 24 roots has a zero husk step.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
